Quantitatively, the current frame reads p50 73.1 / 63.2 / 37.7 and saturation 0.368 / 0.535 / 0.573 at those three heights — i.e. luma FALLING and saturation RISING near->far, the criterion inverted. The new far box lands on sky, which probe currently reads at p50 181.9-184.6, saturation 0.215-0.320 in the clean band at y 0.06-0.14; the new near box lands on ground 28 m out, which the current frame reads at p50 37.7, saturation 0.573 at the same y-frac. That is +144 code values against a >= 20 requirement and -0.29 saturation against a >= 0.15 requirement.

PREDICTED SHORTFALL, DECLARED IN ADVANCE. The critic's second half of the same criterion — `probe crop shots/phone-valley-rN.png 0.35,0.28,0.30,0.20` must show ground falling away — **will still show no terrain**, and that is arithmetic, not a failed fix. That crop spans y-frac 0.28 to 0.48, i.e. elevations +2.7 deg to -6.1 deg. In this direction the land falls monotonically to a basin and never rises again, so the terrain horizon is the near lip and sits at about **-7.3 deg**: the top of the visible ground is 1.2 deg BELOW the bottom of the critic's crop. Putting terrain into that crop needs pitch <= -12 deg, which takes the sun disc out of the top of the frame (13.0 deg elevation against a pitch+22 top edge) and with it the only occluder-and-disc pairing this frame has. The drop is instead delivered at y-frac 0.50-0.72, and the honest instrument for it is `probe crop shots/phone-valley-rN.png 0.30,0.50,0.36,0.24`. This is being reported as a shortfall before the frame exists rather than after.

PREDICTION, §7 BUDGET, and it is a proof rather than an estimate. `valley` currently submits 86 draw calls and 745,447 triangles; the worst pose is `wide` at 116 / 851,417 against caps of 140 / 900,000. CLAIM: for every world-static object, the new frustum is a strict SUBSET of the old one, so static submitted triangles can only fall. PROOF: decompose the translation in the OLD camera's frame. It is 65.96 m horizontally along the view bearing (1.65 deg off it) and +7.69 m vertically... in axis terms, t_par = **64.99 m** along the view axis, with perpendicular offsets of **11.71 m vertical** and **1.91 m lateral**. A point P at axial depth s from the old apex lies in the new frustum only if |p_perp - t_perp| <= (s - t_par)*k; then |p_perp| <= (s - t_par)*k + |t_perp| <= s*k whenever |t_perp| <= t_par*k. Vertically k = tan(22 deg) = 0.4040 and t_par*k = **26.26 m >= 11.71**; horizontally k = tan(41.16 deg) = 0.8743 and t_par*k = **56.82 m >= 1.91**. Both hold, so the containment is unconditional in s up to the far plane, which is unchanged at 6200 m against a 2048 m clipmap. (Headroom: the eye could rise to 17.7 m before the vertical test fails. It rises 3.7 m.)

PREDICTION, §7 BUDGET, the number. The only geometry the subset proof does not cover is camera-relative: the six clipmap rings, the distant band cylinder, the sky dome and the water plane, all of which travel with the camera. Their whole-scene cost is terrain 82,656 tris / 12 calls plus sky 1,840 / 1 call. `valley` already draws terrain today, so the true addition is a subset of that. HARD UPPER BOUND: 745,447 + 82,656 + 1,840 = **829,943 triangles**, which is below the current worst pose (851,417) and 70,057 below the §7 cap. PREDICT the actual figure at **700,000-790,000 triangles and 78-95 draw calls**, and PREDICT that `valley` does NOT become the worst pose in the set. FALSIFIABLE: if report-r17*.json shows perShot/valley/triangles above 829,943 or drawCalls above 100, the subset argument is wrong and this pose must be reverted, not tuned.

CAVEAT ON THE BUDGET PROOF, stated because it is the one hole. The rig's triangle counter includes the shadow passes, and CSM cascades are fitted to the camera frustum rather than being a subset of the old ones, so the proof does not formally cover them. The direction is favourable and it is not close: the cascades move 66 m away from the shrine and point down the empty valley, the level props that dominate the shadow cost (level/level:proxy:0,0 at 301,182 tris over 3 calls and level/lantern:__lanternStone at 121,824 over 3 calls) move behind the camera, and foliage does not cast at MEDIUM. Only terrain rings l0 and l1 cast, and they are camera-relative and already counted in the bound above.
